note: PostFinance's prices for private customers: the Smart bank package, for adults from 20, costs 5 francs a month per customer relationship (free with investments of 25,000 francs, a life insurance or a mortgage, not modelled); under 20 the SmartYoung package is free, so the game waives it there. A customer living outside Switzerland and Liechtenstein pays 25 francs a month more per account, not modelled. Read again 2026-10-30 (the columns are the debit cards by package; Smart's is the second): withdrawals at PostFinance's Postomats cost nothing, francs at another bank's Bancomat in Switzerland CHF 2.– (free with SmartPlus), abroad CHF 5.–; purchases abroad carry a 1.5% processing surcharge; electronic payments at home are free; a payment abroad to an account worldwide online costs CHF 2.– with the recipient bearing other charges (CHF 7.– to 22.– with the sender bearing them; a SEPA transfer free). Not stated in what was read: overdraft (a reminder for an overdrawn account costs CHF 30.–, the first free), a returned payment, interest (published separately), what opening asks.
